retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist studio portrait featuring two subjects in slip dresses with oversized, high-contrast serif typography overlapping the background and subjects.
triggerTerms: minimalist white studio portrait with pastel accents

recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, high-key studio photograph of two women in elegant slip dresses, framed by a massive, light-blue serif title at the top and a smaller, warm-toned subtitle at the bottom right.
coreVisualRelationships: Large-scale typography overlapping the heads of the subjects
High-key white background creating a stark silhouette for the dark dresses
Vertical alignment of subjects contrasting with horizontal span of the header
Cool-toned header vs warm-toned footer text
coreInvariants: High-contrast serif typography with thin hairlines
Clean white studio environment with soft floor shadows
Subjects positioned centrally or slightly off-center in full-length view

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two full-length figures positioned centrally, occupying the middle vertical third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, light-blue serif text at the top edge.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large header, moves down through the subjects' faces and dresses, ending at the small text in the bottom right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space on the left and right sides of the subjects, emphasizing a clean, airy feel.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and sage green of the dresses.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale sky blue for the header and terracotta for the footer.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High-value, low-saturation background contrasted with high-value, high-saturation skin tones and dark garments.

letterConstructionRules: Extreme contrast between thick stems and hairline serifs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme scale contrast between a massive display Didone and a small, humble humanist serif.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast, elegant 90s fashion aesthetic.
Provides the specific verticality and sharp serifs seen in the header.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key studio photograph of two women in full-length slip dresses (one black, one sage) standing against a seamless white background with soft floor shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a massive pale blue serif title across the top, overlapping the subjects' hair, and a small terracotta serif subtitle in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the header text large enough to overlap the subjects?
Is the background pure white with minimal shadows?
Is the contrast in the display font high (thin hairlines)?
Is the bottom text small and positioned in the lower right quadrant?

postGenerationChecks: Check for clean edges on typography
Ensure subjects are in sharp focus
Verify the pale blue color is not too saturated
Confirm the overlap between text and subject looks intentional
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key studio portrait + Massive Didone header + Minimalist color palette
